newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Mint awards copper contracts.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Mint awards copper contracts.

text.p: The United States Mint announced Wednesday that it had awarded contracts to three companies for the purchase of 1,629,000 kilograms of copper for a total price of $4,007,545.30.

The Mint said it will purchase 1,377,000 kilograms of copper from Gerald Metals for a price of $3,384,596.30; 57,000 kilograms from Kataman Metals Inc for a price of $141,816.00 and 195,000 kilograms from Bal Metal for a total price of $481,133.00
